content.short: Slide.so enables dApps to deliver effortless Web3 experiences to users.
content.description: Slide-enabled dapps let users purchase NFTs with traditional payment methods across Ethereum, Solana, Arbitrum, OP Mainnet, Polygon, Avalanche, Aptos, without Web3 experience or wallet installs. The integration is gasless and seamless, featuring a customizable UI and support for batching transactions. Users can create a wallet by logging in with an email or social account, and the protocol provides in-dapp crypto-to-fiat conversion.
